fix: FETCHING lock not released after successful content sync

When fetch_articles_without_content() successfully fetches article content
via sync_article_content(), the article status stays at FETCHING(6)
permanently because the code only prints a success log but never resets
the status back to ACTIVE(1).

The fix: restore original status after successful content fetch, same as
the failure path already does.

Root cause: missing article.status = original_status_map.get(...) and
session.commit() in the success branch.

Impact: 88 articles stuck at status=6 on a deployed instance, invisible
to users despite having fully fetched content.

fix(jobs/mps): empty mps_id 应该 fallback 到所有公众号

UI 编辑消息任务时提示「留空则对所有公众号生效」，但点击执行
或测试会报错 `Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)`。

根因：jobs/mps.py 的 get_feeds() 第一行直接 json.loads(task.mps_id)，
当 mps_id 是空字符串时 json 解析抛异常，永远走不到函数底部已经
存在的 fallback：

    if len(mps)==0:
       mps=wx_db.get_all_mps()

加一个 truthy guard，空字符串解析为 []，让 fallback 正常生效。

影响范围：
- apis/message_task.py /{task_id}/run endpoint
- apis/message_task.py /message/test/{task_id} endpoint
（两个都调 get_feeds）

测试：在容器内构造 mps_id='' 的 task，get_feeds() 正确返回
全部 39 个订阅公众号。

fix(apis/message_task): run endpoint 在 mps_id 为空时 count 显示 0

执行消息任务后 UI 提示「执行成功，共执行更新 0 个订阅号」，
但实际后台已经把 39 个订阅公众号塞进任务队列开始跑了。

根因和上一个 commit 是同一个：apis/message_task.py:202 的
`ids=json.loads(task.mps_id)` 在 mps_id 为空字符串时抛异常，
被 try/except 吞掉，count 留 0。

修法：直接调用已经修复过的 get_feeds(task) 拿真实 feed 列表，
count 反映实际触发的订阅号数（含 mps_id 为空时 fallback 的全量）。
顺便把 mps_list 也补上 name 字段方便前端展示。

fix: add timeout to all HTTP requests to prevent indefinite hangs

requests library defaults to timeout=None (infinite wait). When a remote
server becomes unresponsive due to network issues, the calling thread
blocks permanently. This affects:

- WeChat API article fetching (web.py): added connect/read timeout (10,30)
- Webhook callbacks (webhook.py): added 30s timeout
- Notice functions (custom/wechat/dingtalk/feishu): added 30s timeout

The bark notice already had timeout=10 and was not changed.

Without these timeouts, any network hiccup can hang the queue worker
thread indefinitely, blocking all subsequent tasks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: prevent event loop blocking and add queue task timeout

Two related fixes for server unresponsiveness:

1. apis/message_task.py: test_message_task is an async endpoint that
   called web_hook() synchronously. If the webhook request hangs, this
   blocks the entire uvicorn event loop, freezing all HTTP responses.
   Changed to await asyncio.to_thread() so the blocking call runs in a
   thread pool without stalling the event loop.

2. core/queue/queue.py: the queue worker thread executes tasks with no
   timeout. A single hung task blocks all subsequent tasks permanently.
   Wrapped task execution in ThreadPoolExecutor with a 600s timeout,
   so the worker can recover and process remaining tasks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: enable SQLite WAL mode and filter invalid faker_id

1. Add SQLite PRAGMAs on each new connection:
   - journal_mode=WAL: allows concurrent reads/writes instead of
     serializing them. Critical because the app runs two queue worker
     threads plus cron jobs and uvicorn, all accessing SQLite.
   - busy_timeout=10000: wait 10s instead of immediately failing on lock.
   - synchronous=NORMAL: balances safety and performance.

2. Filter 'MP_WXS_FEATURED_ARTICLES' from get_all_mps():
   This special feed has a literal string 'MP_WXS_FEATURED_ARTICLES' as
   its faker_id, which is not a valid WeChat account ID. When queued as
   the first task, the WeChat API call with this invalid ID hangs,
   blocking the entire queue.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: 修复扫码授权二维码无法显示的问题

二维码无法显示由三个问题叠加导致：

1. anti_crawler_config 通过 extra_http_headers 给所有请求（包括页面XHR）
   强加 Cache-Control 和 Upgrade-Insecure-Requests 头，而真实浏览器只在
   导航请求上发送这两个头。mp.weixin.qq.com 登录页检测到后初始化中止，
   #app 保持 visibility:hidden，二维码 src 永远为空（实测100%复现，
   移除后100%恢复）。

2. wxLogin 用 wait_for_event("framenavigated") 判断登录成功，但新版登录
   页内嵌的"微信快捷登录"iframe（open.weixin.qq.com/mpqrconnect）加载时
   也会触发该事件，导致未扫码就误判登录成功、写入空Token，并在 finally
   中删除刚生成的二维码图片，前端持续404。改为 wait_for_url 等待主页面
   真正跳转到 cgi-bin/home。

3. 新版登录页有持续轮询请求，wxLogin 中无超时保护的
   wait_for_load_state("networkidle") 会抛出超时异常直接中断登录流程；
   另外截图前不校验二维码是否可见、是否加载完成，会截出空白图片。
   新增 _wait_qrcode_ready：等待二维码图片可见且真正加载完成，若页面
   默认展示"微信快捷登录"则自动点击"扫码登录"切换回二维码模式。

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(driver): support BROWSER_TYPE env var to override Chrome auto-detection

When WeChat public platform is reached via a locally detected Chrome
binary on Windows, the platform's anti-bot triggers and the QR code
fails to load (二维码加载超时). Allow users to force a specific
Playwright browser (webkit/chromium/firefox/msedge) via the
BROWSER_TYPE environment variable, bypassing the heuristic that
overrides the default browser_type with the local Chrome path.

Example:
    BROWSER_TYPE=webkit python main.py

This restores cross-platform portability: explicit user preference
takes precedence over auto-detection, while the existing default
(Playwright webkit when no Chrome is detected) is unchanged.

feat(api): add POST /auth/wechat/unbind endpoint to release WeChat authorization

The application stores the WeChat MP token in two places:
1. Local file ./data/wx.lic (via driver.token.wx_cfg)
2. Redis under the werss: prefix (token + login status)

Previously the only way to clear this state was to delete the file by
hand, which the Web UI did not expose. Add a POST endpoint that clears
both stores and resets the in-memory login flag, so a front-end
"解除授权" button can be wired up.

Behaviour:
- 200 OK with cleared_local_token, cleared_redis_keys, and a hint
  to re-authorize via the existing QR code endpoint.
- Returns 50002 on failure.

No breaking changes: all existing endpoints, request/response shapes,
and the default auth flow are untouched.

feat(core): add SwitchJobManager for async background task tracking

Provides a process-wide singleton for tracking WeChat account switch
jobs with the following contract:

- create_job(user_id, target_username) -> SwitchJob
- get_job(job_id) / list_jobs()
- update(job_id, **fields) -> snapshot pushed to all SSE listeners
- finish(job_id, ok, message) -> marks finished_at and final ok
- subscribe(job_id) / unsubscribe(job_id, q): async queues for SSE

Used by apis/auth.py to expose POST /auth/switch (returns job_id),
GET /auth/switch/status (poll) and GET /auth/switch/progress (SSE).

Design choices:
- Single in-memory dict guarded by a threading.Lock (jobs are short-lived,
  not persisted). At most 32 recent jobs are retained; older finished
  ones are evicted FIFO by finished_at.
- Each SwitchJob has its own listeners list, with snapshots dispatched
  via asyncio.Queue.put_nowait, so SSE subscribers cannot block the
  producer.
- Snapshots are JSON-serialisable dicts (stage, message, progress, ok,
  started_at, finished_at).

feat(api): async switch account with status polling and SSE progress

Convert POST /api/v1/auth/switch to return job_id immediately, then run
the actual Playwright-driven switch in a background thread. Front-end
can poll GET /api/v1/auth/switch/status or stream GET
/api/v1/auth/switch/progress (Server-Sent Events).

Why:
The previous synchronous implementation blocked the HTTP request for up
to 3 minutes (120s queue drain + 60s token-expired sleep + Playwright
clicks). The front-end just spun forever with no feedback.

New flow:
1. POST /auth/switch -> 200 OK with {job_id, stage: queued} in < 200ms
2. Background thread runs Wx.switch_account(..., progress_callback)
3. Each step (stop_queues / checking_token / starting_browser /
   clicking / done / failed) updates the job and emits a snapshot to
   subscribers.
4. GET /auth/switch/status?job_id -> snapshot, code=200/403/404
5. GET /auth/switch/progress?job_id -> SSE stream with heartbeats

Security:
- /switch/status and /switch/progress both require Bearer auth.
- A job is only visible to its owner (job.user_id matched against the
  current JWT claim), otherwise 403. Prevents guessing/snooping.
- Completed jobs are evicted FIFO after 32 entries; if the requested
  job_id is unknown, returns 404.

No breaking changes to existing endpoints or response envelopes.

refactor(driver): switch_account accepts progress callback and stops 60s sleep

Make Wx.switch_account emit granular progress events through an
optional callback, so the caller (apis.auth.switch_wechat_account)
can fan them out to SSE / polling endpoints.

Behaviour changes:
- Replace the 60-second asyncio.sleep on token-expired path with an
  immediate return + explicit 'failed' stage, so the front-end can
  surface 'please re-scan QR' instead of waiting a minute.
- The 120-second queue drain is now configurable via SWITCH_MAX_WAIT
  env var (default unchanged).
- Each phase (stopping_queues / checking_token / starting_browser /
  clicking / done / failed) emits (stage, message, progress).
- finally clause no longer unconditionally calls self.cleanup_resources
  + self.Close; it only restores queues. Resource cleanup is the
  caller's responsibility if needed.
- Stage messages map to UI-friendly Chinese (e.g. '打开账号面板…',
  '找到 N 个可切换账号，正在选择…', '切换成功：<name>').

No breaking signature change: the existing sync callers that pass only
'username' still work because progress_callback defaults to None.

feat(core): add ExportJobManager for async article-export task tracking

Mirror of core/switch_job.py for article-export jobs. Tracks total /
processed / skipped records, current stage, progress, output_path.

Hardens update() to only accept a documented allowlist of fields, so a
future caller cannot overwrite listeners or other internal state via
setattr. push_event() now logs (instead of silently swallowing) when an
SSE listener queue is full, so dropped events are observable.

feat(core): optimized batch article exporter with browser reuse

Original apis/tools.py:_export_articles_worker called url_to_pdf() once
per article, which launched a fresh Playwright browser (5-15s of startup
per article) and forced chromium regardless of the BROWSER_TYPE env
override. For an mp with 86 articles this meant 8-21 minutes of pure
browser-start overhead and frequent failures because chromium/firefox
weren't installed via 'playwright install'.

This module batches all PDF rendering through a single
WebToPDFConverter so the browser is launched once per export job
instead of once per article.

Browser selection priority:
1. BROWSER_TYPE env var (when set to webkit / chromium / firefox / msedge)
2. Auto-detect installed Playwright browser cache (~/.cache/ms-playwright
   or %LOCALAPPDATA%/ms-playwright on Windows)
3. config.gather.browser_type
4. Default: webkit (matches the BROWSER_TYPE patch in this branch)

A progress_callback(stage, message, progress, **kw) is invoked at every
state transition (counting / preparing / rendering_pdfs /
writing_files / packaging / done / failed) so the API layer can fan
out to SSE / polling clients.

Other speedups baked in:
- Skip articles with empty content or empty url before any heavy work.
- Cap page_count via .limit() at query time instead of offset-loop.
- Use os.path.join instead of f-string concatenation for portability.
- Each PDF generation failure is caught per-article so one bad page
  does not abort the batch.

feat(api): async article export with status polling and SSE progress

Convert POST /api/v1/wx/tools/export/articles to return job_id
immediately, then run the actual export in a background thread.
Front-end can poll GET /api/v1/wx/tools/export/status or stream
GET /api/v1/wx/tools/export/progress (Server-Sent Events).

Why:
The previous synchronous implementation blocked the HTTP request for the
entire export — 86 articles × ~15s per browser launch = 8-21 minutes of
pure wait, often failing partway through because chromium/firefox weren't
installed. The front-end just hung with no feedback.

New flow:
1. POST /tools/export/articles -> 200 OK with {job_id, ...} in < 50ms
2. Background thread runs core.exporter._export_articles_optimized,
   emitting progress events to ExportJobManager.
3. After all articles are written the thread zips them up and
   removes the originals, then manager.finish() publishes ok=True and
   output_path.
4. GET /export/status?job_id=X -> current snapshot (403 if not owner)
5. GET /export/progress?job_id=X -> SSE stream with 15s heartbeats

Security:
- All three new endpoints are auth-protected via
  get_current_user_or_ak (Bearer JWT or Access Key).
- A job is only visible to its owner (job.user_id == JWT subject);
  otherwise 403. Prevents snooping by guessing 12-char hex job_ids.
- export_path in the response is reduced to basename() so the absolute
  server filesystem path is not leaked.
- Unknown job_id returns 404.

Behaviour changes:
- The single-thread guard by mp_id is preserved (refuses re-entry while
  an export for the same mp_id is in flight) so multiple POSTs for the
  same mp don't race each other.
- The zip is still cleaned up by the background thread itself; no
  FileResponse ownership change.
